headline: OpenAI launches 'Health in ChatGPT' for personalized medical insights by integrating Apple Health for U.S. users.

items.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced 'Health in ChatGPT', a feature that allows eligible U.S. users to securely integrate their Apple Health data and medical records. This integration aims to provide more personalized health insights and enhance users' understanding of their health metrics through AI-driven analysis.
items.why_it_matters: This development underscores the growing intersection of AI and healthcare, offering software engineers a new avenue to explore AI integration with health data, potentially revolutionizing personalized health insights.

items.title: Copilot vs. raw API access: What are you actually paying for?
items.summary: GitHub Copilot now bills users based on API usage rates, prompting a comparison between direct API model access and the integrated coding workflow Copilot offers. This change highlights the cost implications and the additional benefits of using Copilot's integrated environment for software development.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding the cost and value difference between API access and integrated tools like Copilot is crucial for tech leads in managing budgets and optimizing development workflows.
